review_candidates.title: Senior Azure Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Azure Systems Engineer to be responsible for building, operating, and maintaining enterprise-grade system infrastructure natively on Microsoft Azure, as well as managing complex hybrid-cloud environments. This role acts as a bridge between traditional systems administration and modern cloud operations, focus areas including operating system management (Linux/Windows), hybrid connectivity, virtualization, and identity systems within the cloud ecosystem. Key
eligibility_evidence: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Azure Systems Engineer to be responsible for building, operating, and maintaining enterprise-grade system infrastructure natively on Microsoft Azure, as well as managing complex hybrid-cloud environments.

This role acts as a bridge between traditional systems administration and modern cloud operations, focus areas including operating system management (Linux/Windows), hybrid connectivity, virtualization, and identity systems within the cloud ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities Hybrid Systems Infrastructure: Build and manage scalable architectures linking on-premises systems, legacy datacenters, and edge networks directly to Microsoft Azure using technologies like Azure Arc and ExpressRoute.
Modernized, reliable server infrastructure operating with 99.99% uptime across both cloud and hybrid environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Experience: 5+ years of systems engineering experience, with at least 3+ years architecting and supporting enterprise systems workflows in Microsoft Azure. Practical expertise scriptwriting in PowerShell or Python to automate repetitive system tasks. Platform Proficiencies: Proven track record deploying core Azure IaaS components (Virtual Machines, Managed Disks, Virtual Networks, Key Vault, and Blob Storage). We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions.
